lines.coptic: Ⲁ̀ⲣⲓⲯⲁⲗⲓⲛ ⲉ̀ⲫⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲩⲁϣϥ: ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲛ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲩⲕⲟⲥϥ: ⲁϥⲧⲱⲛϥ ⲁϥⲕⲱⲣϥ ⲙ̀ⲫ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲁϥϯϣⲟϣϥ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲁⲥϥ.

translations.english: O sing unto Him who was crucified, buried and resurrected, who trampled and abolished death, praise Him and exalt Him above all.

transliterations.english: Aripsalin efee-etavashf: e-ehree egon o-woh avkosf: aftonf afkorf emefmou aftishoshf: hos erof arihowo chasf.

sung.english: O sing unto Him who was crucified, buried and resurrected for us, who trampled and abolished death, praise Him and exalt Him above all.

lines.coptic: Ⲃⲱϣ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲣⲱⲙⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡⲁⲗⲉⲟⲥ: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ϫⲱⲗϩ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲃⲉⲣⲓ ⲉⲩⲕ̀ⲗⲉⲟⲥ: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉ̀ϧⲱⲛⲧ ⲉ̀ⲙⲉⲅⲁⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲟⲥ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲁⲥϥ.

translations.english: Take off the old man, and put on the new and superior one, come closer to greatness of mercy, praise Him and exalt Him above all.

transliterations.english: Vosh empiromi empaleos: o-woh golh empiveri evekleos: o-woh ekhont emegha-eleos: hos erof arihowo chasf.

sung.english: Take off the old man, and put on the new and superior one, come closer to the greatness of mercy, praise Him and exalt Him above all.

lines.coptic: Ⲅⲉⲛⲟⲥ ⲛ̀Ⲛⲓⲭ̀ⲣⲓⲥⲧⲓⲁⲛⲟⲥ: ⲛⲓⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲥⲃⲩⲧⲉⲣⲟⲥ ⲕⲉ ⲇⲓⲁⲕⲟⲛⲟⲥ: ⲙⲁⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲙ̀Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ϫⲉ ⲟⲩϩⲓⲕⲁⲛⲟⲥ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲁⲥϥ.

translations.english: All you Christian people, the priests and the deacons, glorify the Lord for He is worthy, praise Him and exalt Him above all.

transliterations.english: Genos enni-ekhristianos: ni-epresviteros ke thiakonos: ma-oou emepshois je ouhikanos: hos erof arihowo chasf.

lines.coptic: Ⲇⲉⲩⲧⲉ ϩⲁⲣⲟⲛ ⲱ̀ ⲡⲓϣⲟⲙⲧ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲗⲟⲩ: ⲉ̀ⲧⲁ Ⲡⲓⲭ̀ⲣⲓⲥⲧⲟⲥ Ⲡⲉⲛⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲟ̀ⲗⲟⲩ: ⲁϥⲛⲁϩⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϩⲁ Ⲡⲓⲇⲓⲁⲃⲟⲗⲟⲩ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲁⲥϥ.

translations.english: Come to us O three children, whom Christ our God has lifted, and from the Devil has delivered, praise Him and exalt Him above all.

transliterations.english: Thevte haron o pishomt enalou: eta Pi-ekhristos Pennoti olou: afnahmou evol ha Pithiavolou: hos erof arihowo chasf.

lines.coptic: Ⲉⲑⲃⲉ Ⲡⲉⲕⲛⲟⲩϯ Ⲙⲁⲥⲓⲁⲥ: Ⲫ̀ⲣⲉϥϯ ⲛ̀ⲉⲩⲉⲣⲅⲉⲥⲓⲁⲥ: ⲁ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ϣⲁⲣⲟⲛ Ⲁ̀ⲛⲁⲛⲓⲁⲥ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲁⲥϥ.

translations.english: For the sake of your God the Messiah, the Giver of all good things, come unto us O Hananiah, praise Him and exalt Him above all.

transliterations.english: Ethve Peknoti Masias: Efrefti enevergesias: amou sharon Ananias: hos erof arihowo chasf.

lines.coptic: Ⲍⲏⲗⲱⲧⲉ Ⲁ̀ⲍⲁⲣⲓⲁⲥ: ⲉⲥⲡⲉⲣⲁⲥ ⲕⲉ ⲡ̀ⲣⲱⲓ̀ ⲕⲉ ⲙⲉⲥⲏⲙ ⲃ̀ⲣⲓⲁⲥ: ⲙⲁⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧ̀ϫⲟⲙ ⲛ̀Ϯⲧ̀ⲣⲓⲁⲥ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲁⲥϥ.

translations.english: O Azariah the zealot, morning and noon and the evening, glorify the power of the Trinity, praise Him and exalt Him above all.

transliterations.english: Zeelote Azarias: esperas ke epro-i ke meseem evrias: ma-oou enetgom enti-etrias: hos erof arihowo chasf.

sung.english: O Azariah the zealot, evening and morning and at noon, glorify the power of the trinity, praise Him and exalt Him above all.

stanzas.coptic: ⲉⲥⲡⲉⲣⲁⲥ ⲕⲉ ⲡ̀ⲣⲱⲓ̀ ⲕⲉ ⲙⲉⲥⲏⲙ ⲃ̀ⲣⲓⲁⲥ:

lines.coptic: Ⲏⲡⲡⲉ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲓⲥ Ⲉⲙⲙⲁⲛⲟⲩⲏⲗ: ϩⲓ ⲧⲉⲛⲙⲏϯ ⲱ̀ Ⲙⲓⲥⲁⲏⲗ: ⲗⲁⲗⲓ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲥ̀ⲙⲏ ⲛ̀ⲑⲉⲗⲏⲗ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲁⲥϥ.

translations.english: Behold Emmanuel [our Lord], is now in our midst O Mishael, proclaim with the voice of joy, praise Him and exalt Him above all.

transliterations.english: Eeppe ghar is Emmanoweel: hi tenmeeti o Misaeel: lali khen ou-esmee entheleel: hos erof arihowo chasf.

sung.english: Behold Emmanuel, is now in our midst O Mishael, proclaim with the voice of joy, praise Him and exalt Him above all.

lines.coptic: Ⲑⲱⲟⲩϯ ϯⲛⲟⲩ ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲭⲓⲛ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ: ⲥⲁϫⲓ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲥⲃⲩⲧⲉⲣⲟⲩ: ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲛⲉϥϩ̀ⲃⲏⲟⲩⲓ̀ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲁⲥϥ.

translations.english: Gather now and persevere, and proclaim with the priests, bless the Lord all His works, praise Him and exalt Him above all.

transliterations.english: Thoouti tinou kata shin teerou: saji nem ni-epresviterou: esmou e-epshois nefehveeoui teerou: hos erof arihowo chasf.

lines.coptic: Ⲓⲥ ⲛⲓⲫⲏⲟⲩⲓ̀ ⲥⲉⲥⲁϫⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡ̀ⲱ̀ⲟⲩ: ⲙ̀Ⲫ̀ⲛⲟⲩϯ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ϧⲟⲩⲛ ⲙ̀ⲫⲟⲟⲩ: ⲱ̀ ⲛⲓⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ ⲉ̀ⲧⲁϥϫ̀ⲫⲱⲟⲩ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲁⲥϥ.

translations.english: The heavens declare the glory, of God until this day, O you angels whom He has made, praise Him and exalt Him above all.

transliterations.english: Is nifeeoui sesaji emepoou: emefnoti sha ekhoun emfoou: o niangelos etafegfoou: hos erof arihowo chasf.

lines.coptic: Ⲕⲉ ⲛⲩⲛ ⲇⲩⲛⲁⲙⲓⲥ ⲧⲟⲩ Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲟⲩ: ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲡⲉϥⲣⲁⲛ ⲧⲟⲩ ⲧⲓⲙⲓⲟⲩ: ⲡⲓⲣⲏ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲓⲟϩ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲥⲓⲟⲩ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲁⲥϥ.

translations.english: Now all you powers of the Lord, bless His honored name, O sun and moon and all the stars, praise Him and exalt Him above all.

transliterations.english: Ke nin thinamis tou Kiriou: esmou epefran tou timiou: piree nem pioh nem nisiou: hos erof arihowo chasf.

lines.coptic: Ⲗⲟⲓⲡⲟⲛ ⲛⲓⲙⲟⲩⲛ̀ϩⲱⲟⲩ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲓⲱϯ: ⲉⲩⲫⲏⲙⲓⲥⲁ ⲧⲉ Ⲡⲉⲛⲣⲉϥⲥⲱϯ: ϫⲉ ⲛ̀ⲑⲟϥ ⲡⲉ Ⲫ̀ⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲉⲛⲓⲟϯ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲁⲥϥ.

translations.english: And also you rain and dew, sing praises unto our Savior, for He is the God of our fathers, praise Him and exalt Him above all.

transliterations.english: Loipon nimou-enhoou nem nioti: evfeemisa te Penrefsoti: je enthof pe Efnoti ente nenioti: hos erof arihowo chasf.

sung.english: And also O you rain and dew, sing praises unto our Savior, for He is God of our fathers, praise Him and exalt Him above all.

stanzas.coptic: ϫⲉ ⲛ̀ⲑⲟϥ ⲡⲉ Ⲫ̀ⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲉⲛⲓⲟϯ:

lines.coptic: Ⲙⲁⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲙ̀Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲱ̀ ⲛⲓϭⲏⲡⲓ ⲉⲩⲙⲁ: ⲛⲓⲑⲏⲟⲩ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲛⲓϥⲓ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ: ⲡⲓϫⲁϥ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲭ̀ⲣⲱⲙ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲕⲁⲩⲙⲁ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲁⲥϥ.

translations.english: Glorify the Lord O clouds and winds, together with the souls and the spirits, O you cold and fire and heat, praise Him and exalt Him above all.

transliterations.english: Ma-oou emepshois o nicheepi evma: nitheeou nem ninifi nem ni-epnevma: pigaf nem pi-ekrom nem pikavma: hos erof arihowo chasf.

lines.coptic: Ⲛⲩⲕⲧⲉⲥ ⲕⲉ ⲏ̀ⲙⲉⲣⲉⲣⲱ ⲡⲉ: ⲫⲱⲥ ⲕⲉ ⲥ̀ⲕⲟⲧⲟⲥ ⲕⲉ ⲁⲥⲧ̀ⲣⲁⲡⲉ: ϫⲉ ⲇⲟⲝⲁ ⲥⲓ Ⲫⲓⲗⲁⲛⲑ̀ⲣⲱⲡⲉ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲁⲥϥ.

translations.english: You also nights and days, light and darkness and lightning, glorify the Lover of Mankind, praise Him and exalt Him above all.

transliterations.english: Niktes ke eemerero pe: fos ke eskotos ke asetrape: je thoksa si Filanethrope: hos erof arihowo chasf.

lines.coptic: Ⲝⲩⲗⲁ ⲕⲉ ⲡⲁⲛⲧⲁ ⲧⲁ ⲫⲩⲟ̀ⲙⲉⲛⲁ: ⲉⲛ ⲧⲏ ⲅⲏ ⲕⲉ ⲡⲁⲛⲧⲁ ⲧⲁ ⲕⲓⲛⲟⲩⲙⲉⲛⲁ: ϩⲓ ⲛⲓⲙⲱⲟⲩ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲧⲱⲟⲩ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲇ̀ⲣⲩⲙⲟⲛⲁ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲁⲥϥ.

translations.english: You trees and all that springs on the earth, and all that moves in the sea, mountains and the forests, praise Him and exalt Him above all.

transliterations.english: Ksila ke panta ta fi-omena: en tee gee ke panta ta kinoumena: hi nimoou nem nitoou nem ethrimona: hos erof arihowo chasf.

sung.english: You trees and all that springs on the earth, and all that moves in the waters, mountains and the forests, praise Him and exalt Him above all.

stanzas.coptic: ⲉⲛ ⲧⲏ ⲅⲏ ⲕⲉ ⲡⲁⲛⲧⲁ ⲧⲁ ⲕⲓⲛⲟⲩⲙⲉⲛⲁ:
ϩⲓ ⲛⲓⲙⲱⲟⲩ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲧⲱⲟⲩ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲇ̀ⲣⲩⲙⲟⲛⲁ:

lines.coptic: Ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲟⲛ ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲁⲧⲭⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩ: ⲉ̀Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ Ⲡ̀ⲟⲩⲣⲟ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲟⲩⲣⲱⲟⲩ: ⲛⲓⲁ̀ⲙⲁⲓⲟⲩ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲓⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲁⲥϥ.

translations.english: Praise without ceasing, the Lord the King of the kings, O you rivers and seas, praise Him and exalt Him above all.

transliterations.english: O-woh on esmou enatkaroou: e-epshois Epouro ente niouroou: ni-amaiou nem niaroou: hos erof arihowo chasf.

lines.coptic: Ⲡⲁⲓⲣⲏϯ ⲁ̀ⲛⲟⲛ ⲧⲉⲛⲛⲁⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲱⲟⲩ: ⲙⲁⲣⲉⲛϫⲟⲥ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲁⲓ ⲱⲛ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ: ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲛⲓϩⲁⲗⲁϯ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲁⲥϥ.

translations.english: And we also seeing them, let us say with all these things, bless the Lord all you birds, praise Him and exalt Him above all.

transliterations.english: Paireeti anon tennav eroou: marengos nem nai on teerou: esmou e-epshois nihalati teerou: hos erof arihowo chasf.

lines.coptic: Ⲣⲱ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓⲡⲁⲭⲛⲏ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲭⲓⲱⲛ: ⲕⲉ ⲕ̀ⲧⲏⲛⲱⲛ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲑⲏⲣⲓⲟⲛ: ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲧⲱⲛ ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲱⲛ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲁⲥϥ.

translations.english: O snow and ice, cattle and wild beasts, bless the Lord of lords, praise Him and exalt Him above all.

transliterations.english: Ro ennipakhnee nem nishion: ke ekteenon nem nitheerion: esmou e-epshois ton kirion: hos erof arihowo chasf.

lines.coptic: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲫ̀ⲧⲱⲙⲓ: ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲕⲉ ⲟⲩ ⲙⲏ ⲡⲁⲣⲁⲛⲟⲙⲓ: ⲱ̀ ⲛⲓϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲣⲱⲙⲓ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲁⲥϥ.

translations.english: Bless the Lord as befits Him, and not like the heretics, all you sons of men, praise Him and exalt Him above all.

transliterations.english: Esmou e-epshois kata eftomi: erof ke ou mee paranomi: o nisheeri ente niromi: hos erof arihowo chasf.

sung.english: Bless the Lord as befits Him, and not like the disobedient, all you sons of men, praise Him and exalt Him above all.

lines.coptic: Ⲧⲓⲙⲏ ⲕⲉ ⲇⲟⲝⲁ ⲱ̀ Ⲡⲓⲥⲣⲁⲏⲗ: ⲓ̀ⲛⲓ ⲛⲁϩⲣⲁϥ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲥ̀ⲙⲏ ⲛ̀ⲑⲉⲗⲏⲗ: ⲛⲓⲟⲩⲏⲃ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲉⲙⲙⲁⲛⲟⲩⲏⲗ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲁⲥϥ.

translations.english: O Israel offer before Him, honor and glory in a joyful voice, all you priests of Emmanuel, praise Him and exalt Him above all.

transliterations.english: Timee ke thoksa o Pisraeel: ini nahraf khen ou-esmee entheleel: nioweeb ente Emmanoweel: hos erof arihowo chasf.

lines.coptic: Ⲩ̀ⲡⲏⲣⲉⲧⲱⲛ ⲙ̀Ⲫ̀ⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲙ̀ⲙⲏⲓ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲯⲩⲭⲏ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲑ̀ⲙⲏⲓ: ⲛⲏⲉⲧⲑⲉⲃⲓⲏⲟⲩⲧ ⲛ̀ⲣⲉϥⲙⲉⲓ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲁⲥϥ.

translations.english: You servants of the true God, the souls of the righteous, and the humble and the charitable, praise Him and exalt Him above all.

transliterations.english: Ipeereton emefnoti emmee: nem nipsishee ente ni-ethmee: nee-etthevieeout enrefmei: hos erof arihowo chasf.

lines.coptic: Ⲫ̀ⲛⲟⲩϯ Ⲡⲁⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲉ̀ⲅⲱ: Ⲡⲉⲧⲉⲛⲣⲉϥⲥⲱϯ ⲉⲕ ⲧⲟⲛ ⲁ̀ⲅⲱ: Ⲥⲉⲇⲣⲁⲕ Ⲙⲓⲥⲁⲕ Ⲁⲃⲇⲉⲛⲁⲅⲱ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲁⲥϥ.

translations.english: God my God is the One, who saved you from danger, O Sedrach Misach and Abednago, praise Him and exalt Him above all.

transliterations.english: Efnoti Panoti egho: Petenrefsoti ek ton agho: Sedrak Misak Abdenagho: hos erof arihowo chasf.

lines.coptic: Ⲭⲱⲗⲉⲙ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲛⲓϣϯ ⲛ̀ϣ̀ⲣⲱⲓⲥ: ⲱ̀ ⲛⲏⲉⲧⲉⲣⲥⲉⲃⲉⲥⲑⲉ ⲙ̀Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲫⲩⲥⲓⲥ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲧⲁϥⲁⲓⲥ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲁⲥϥ.

translations.english: Hurry with great haste, O you righteous of the Lord, and all the creatures He has made, praise Him and exalt Him above all.

transliterations.english: Kolem khen ounishti eneshrois: o nee-eterseveste emepshois: nem nifisis teerou etafais: hos erof arihowo chasf.

lines.coptic: Ⲯⲩⲭⲟⲥ ⲕⲉ ⲁ̀ⲛⲁⲡⲁⲩⲥⲓⲥ: ⲙⲟⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲧⲏⲣⲉⲛ ⲭⲱⲣⲓⲥ ⲑ̀ⲣⲁⲩⲥⲓⲥ: ⲉⲑⲣⲉⲛϫⲱ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲁ̀ⲡⲟⲗⲁⲩⲥⲓⲥ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲁⲥϥ.

translations.english: Coolness and repose without ceasing, grant unto all of us, that we may joyfully proclaim, praise Him and exalt Him above all.

transliterations.english: Psikhos ke anapavsis: moi nan teeren khoris ethravsis: ethrengo khen o-apolavsis: hos erof arihowo chasf.

lines.coptic: Ⲱ̀ⲥⲁⲩⲧⲱⲥ ⲡⲉⲕⲃⲱⲕ ⲡⲓⲡ̀ⲧⲱⲭⲟⲥ: Ⲥⲁⲣⲕⲓⲥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓⲧϥ ⲉϥⲟⲓ ⲛ̀ⲉⲛⲟⲭⲟⲥ: ⲉ̀ⲥⲁϫⲓ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲁⲓ ϩⲱⲥ ⲙⲉⲧⲟⲭⲟⲥ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲁⲥϥ.

translations.english: And also Your poor servant Sarkis, make him without condemnation, that he may join all those and say, praise Him and exalt Him above all.

transliterations.english: Osavtos pekvok pi-eptokhos: Sarkis aritf efoi enenokhos: esaji nem nai hos metokhos: hos erof arihowo chasf.
